headlines.title: Police seek witnesses to brawl outside Levi's Stadium during 49ers-Raiders game
headlines.description: Santa Clara police are asking for anyone who witnessed a caught-on-camera brawl outside Levi’s Stadium during Sunday’s San Francisco 49ers-Las Vegas Raiders game to come forward. Video footage of the parking lot fight appeared to show two people knocked unconscious. A police lieutenant at the Levi’s Stadium command post said officers responded to several fights on Sunday. Witnesses to the fights are encouraged to contact police at 408-615-4700. Those wishing to remain nameless can leave a message on the police department’s anonymous tip line at 408-615-4847.
